hero.body: Fragrance and care inspired by lavender fields at twilight: pale petals, slender stems, and quiet green leaves breathing with the light.
hero.art_alt: A translucent perfume bottle layered with lavender forms

showcase.title: Sculpted pieces from this season's harvest
showcase.subtitle: Three formulas selected after 200 distillation trials.

categories.title: Move between categories like a hand moving through stems

aura.title: Six scent families, one aura that reads as you

descriptions.floral: Petals cut at dawn, light dew, and a quiet feminine warmth.
descriptions.woody: Dry stems, white wood, and warm earth after twilight.
descriptions.oriental: Resins, soft spice, and warmth that draws closer over time.
descriptions.fresh: Green leaves, cool air, and translucent water.
descriptions.musky: A clean velvet trail that rests softly on skin.
descriptions.citrus: Bright peel and delicate bitterness opening the senses.

bloom.title: Three layers blooming on skin
bloom.top_text: The first ten minutes: cool citrus and broken green leaf.
bloom.heart_text: After half an hour: lavender opens with violet and jasmine.
bloom.base_text: Until the day ends: musk and white wood close to skin.

routine.title: A flowing routine, not rows of cards
routine.step_1_body: A light lavender-water foam removes traces without dryness.
routine.step_2_body: Sage-leaf toner calms and restores the natural pH.
routine.step_3_body: A concentrated oil warmed between the palms and pressed into skin.
routine.step_4_body: Night cream locks in moisture and leaves a light scented trail.

mood.title: What do you want to feel?
mood.subtitle: Choose a feeling instead of a category and we'll surface the formulas that carry it.

gift.title: Compose a box that opens twice
gift.body: Choose a box shape, then up to three pieces. We add a handwritten card and a coral ribbon.

story.title: The dawn harvest in lavender fields
story.body: We pick petals before sunrise when the oil is most concentrated, then distil them the same day at low heat to preserve the quiet green layers.

product.ingredients_title: Ingredients felt before they are read
product.ingredient_lavender_body: Hand-picked before sunrise when its oil reaches peak concentration.
product.ingredient_violet_body: A translucent floral layer bringing a cool softness to the heart.
product.ingredient_musk_body: A skin-close base that extends the trail without heaviness.
